subject: Ballpark figure needed
body: Morning. Before we go further internally I need a rough idea of spend for a bilingual company site. What sort of range are we looking at?

subject: Nothing loads on our portal
body: Since last night nobody in the office can open the dashboard, it just spins forever. Please sort this out.

subject: Are we still on schedule
body: Could you let me know if the second phase is going to land when we agreed, and what is left outstanding?

subject: Coffee or a call?
body: Would love 20 minutes with someone from your side to talk through what we need. Tuesday morning works for me.

subject: Strange emails pretending to be our director
body: Staff keep getting messages that look like they come from our director asking for gift cards. We are worried someone is inside our system.

subject: Charged again after cancelling
body: We ended the agreement last month but another payment left our account yesterday. Please sort out a refund.

subject: Still no answer
body: This is my second message about the proposal I sent. Nobody has replied and it has been over a week now.

subject: Working together on client projects
body: We handle branding for a number of clients who keep asking about security testing. Could we look at some sort of arrangement where we bring you in?

subject: Can your team handle a booking system
body: We need an online booking and scheduling system for our farm tours. Is that within what you build?

subject: Fresh graduate looking for a start
body: I finished my degree in June and would really like to join your training programme. What do I need to send you?

subject: Formal costing please
body: Kindly provide a written costing for a security review of our head office network, twenty five workstations.

subject: Third time asking and still nothing
body: I have raised the same issue three times now and each time I am told someone will call. Nobody ever does. This is a shambles.

subject: Some background on your firm
body: Before our board meeting could you send whatever you have on your company, previous work and how long you have been operating?

subject: What would ads management run us
body: Curious what you charge monthly to look after a Google Ads account, and whether that includes the ad budget itself.
